units.title: Introduction to AI & Intelligent Agents
units.description: Foundations of AI, agent architectures, PEAS specification, environment classifications.

topics.name: PEAS Model for Autonomous Agents
topics.keywords: peas, performance measure, environment, sensors, actuators
topics.learning_outcome: Formulate PEAS descriptions for diverse agent tasks.

topics.name: Rational Agent Architectures
topics.keywords: rationality, reflex agent, goal-based agent, utility-based
topics.learning_outcome: Classify agent types based on behavioral complexity.

units.title: Problem Solving & Heuristic Search
units.description: Uninformed search, heuristic evaluation, A* search, and game playing with Alpha-Beta pruning.

topics.name: A* Algorithm & Admissibility
topics.keywords: a* search, heuristic function, admissibility, consistency, optimality
topics.learning_outcome: Apply A* search with admissible heuristics to route-finding problems.

topics.name: Adversarial Search & Alpha-Beta Pruning
topics.keywords: minimax, alpha-beta, game trees, branching factor
topics.learning_outcome: Analyze state spaces and prune non-promising branches in two-player games.

units.title: Knowledge Representation & Logical Reasoning
units.description: Propositional logic, first-order predicate calculus, resolution refutation, and ontologies.

topics.name: First-Order Logic & Resolution
topics.keywords: fol, predicate calculus, unification, resolution refutation, cnf
topics.learning_outcome: Execute resolution refutation proofs in first-order logic.

topics.name: Forward & Backward Chaining
topics.keywords: inference engine, horn clauses, rule-based systems
topics.learning_outcome: Differentiate inference mechanisms in expert systems.

units.title: Probabilistic Reasoning & Uncertainty
units.description: Bayesian networks, conditional independence, Markov models, and exact inference.

topics.name: Bayesian Belief Networks
topics.keywords: bayes rule, conditional probability tables, d-separation, inference
topics.learning_outcome: Compute posterior probabilities given observed diagnostic evidence.

topics.name: Markov Decision Processes (MDP)
topics.keywords: bellman equation, value iteration, policy iteration, discount factor
topics.learning_outcome: Formulate sequential decision-making tasks under uncertainty.

units.title: Machine Learning Foundations & Neural Networks
units.description: Supervised learning algorithms, perceptrons, multi-layer networks, backpropagation.

topics.name: Backpropagation & Gradient Descent
topics.keywords: loss function, chain rule, learning rate, weight update
topics.learning_outcome: Derive gradient descent weight update equations for multi-layer perceptrons.

topics.name: Regularization & Generalization
topics.keywords: overfitting, l1 l2 regularization, dropout, cross-validation
topics.learning_outcome: Critique model generalization techniques to prevent overfitting.

units.title: Natural Language Processing & Advanced Architectures
units.description: Text vectorization, sequence models, self-attention mechanisms, and transformer architectures.

topics.name: Self-Attention & Transformer Architecture
topics.keywords: transformer, multi-head attention, positional encoding, qkv matrices
topics.learning_outcome: Design attention-based neural architectures for sequence transduction.

topics.name: AI Ethics & Explainability (XAI)
topics.keywords: bias, fairness, accountability, interpretability, lime, shap
topics.learning_outcome: Evaluate fairness metrics and algorithmic transparency in high-stakes automated decisions.
